description: This file contains utilities for reproducing and debugging issues in PyTorch's Dynamo framework after graph capture, including minification, accuracy testing, repro generation, and debugging backends.

classes.name: WrapBackendDebug
classes.description: A wrapper class for backend functions that adds debugging, minification, and repro generation capabilities during graph compilation in Dynamo.

methods.name: wrap_backend_debug
methods.description: Creates a WrapBackendDebug instance to wrap a compiler function for debugging and minification.

methods.name: generate_dynamo_fx_repro_string
methods.description: Generates a reproducible Python script string for a given FX GraphModule and inputs, suitable for debugging.

methods.name: dump_backend_repro_as_file
methods.description: Saves a repro script to a file, including minified versions if needed.

methods.name: dump_backend_state
methods.description: Attempts to dump the FX graph as a string or save the module to a folder for debugging.

methods.name: dump_to_minify_after_dynamo
methods.description: Creates a minified repro script for a given FX GraphModule.

methods.name: dynamo_minifier_backend
methods.description: Backend that runs the minifier on a FX GraphModule, generating a minimized repro for failure cases.

methods.name: dynamo_accuracy_minifier_backend
methods.description: Backend that checks accuracy and runs minifier if accuracy fails.

methods.name: backend_fails
methods.description: Checks if a minified FX GraphModule fails with a similar error as the original.

methods.name: run_load_args
methods.description: Loads inputs for repro scripts, handling version warnings and progress bar.

methods.name: repro_minify
methods.description: Runs the minifier on a repro script with given options.

methods.name: repro_run
methods.description: Runs a repro script, optionally checking accuracy.

methods.name: run_repro
methods.description: Main function to execute a repro script with command-line argument parsing and subcommands.
